# threedog

> A web 3D game engine on three.js 0.187 (plain three.js, no React): core and modules installed with engine.use. It ships no art: each game draws its own picture (plain three.js in its picture/ folder, and assets).

Taking over a game: its status notes first. A new feature: docs/AI.md or threedog how, then the recipe, then docs/api/<module>.md.

## Start

- [AI.md](docs/AI.md): entry table, commands, verification rules, conventions
- [API.md](docs/API.md): API index; one page per module in docs/api/

## Which one

- Say it happened, no answer; cause chain, randomness: docs/recipes/06-clock-events.md
- Player actions, UI buttons (can refuse): docs/recipes/23-ops.md §1
- A value several systems change; one-holder parts: docs/recipes/55-mods-time-wrap.md §"The rules in full"
- Content: items, NPCs, places, packs; change an entry for good: docs/recipes/20-content-actions-save.md §1b
- Save game, load game, autosave, story flags, counters: docs/recipes/20-content-actions-save.md §4
- Preferences outside the save; turn off my effect: docs/recipes/26-ui-parts.md §6
- Timers, skip time; game time: rules, AI: docs/recipes/06-clock-events.md §1
- What shows: animation, camera, HUD (engine.stepBlend): docs/recipes/06-clock-events.md §1
- Picture per frame: docs/recipes/62-picture-code.md §0

## Picture and sound

- The picture in three.js (picture/): lights, fog, exposure, parts: docs/recipes/62-picture-code.md §0, 34-environment-lighting.md
- Picture, writers; try a value: docs/recipes/52-around-the-picture.md §"Who writes it", 62-picture-code.md §3c
- Materials, textures, a module's picture: docs/recipes/09-materials-lights-models.md §1
- Own material or shader (toon, cel shading): docs/recipes/43-shader-patches-surfaces.md §"Your own material", 56-webgpu-tsl.md §"A minimal TSL material"
- WebGPU (new games' default), TSL node materials, WebGL fallback: docs/recipes/56-webgpu-tsl.md §"WebGPU or WebGL"
- three.js idioms, own renderer: docs/recipes/50-own-renderer.md
- Dust, smoke: docs/recipes/64-particles.md
- Sky, season tints, weather, wet roads: docs/recipes/08-weather-sky.md §1
- Water, rain, snow cover (own rain: THREE.md): docs/recipes/44-water-weather-hooks.md
- Shadows: blur, follow, cost: docs/recipes/45-cascaded-shadows.md
- Own far, fov; clouds: docs/recipes/52-around-the-picture.md §"Atmosphere"
- Environment light, reflections, probes, lightmaps, GI, culling: docs/recipes/34-environment-lighting.md §"Environment maps"
- Post passes: color grading, bloom, outline, depth, AO: docs/recipes/52-around-the-picture.md §"Post effect chain", 59-depth-post-effects.md

## Composing modules

- Replace a module (dialogue, camera): docs/recipes/55-mods-time-wrap.md §"Replacing a module"

## Advanced

- Own ground or plant drawing, keep collision: docs/recipes/28-terrain.md §6
- Worker results, far records' models, raw navmesh or physics, content sections, own mover: docs/recipes/15-perf.md, 18-world.md, 12-navmesh.md, 11-vehicles.md, 14-custom-module.md, 57-control.md

- Broke; describe, explain, shot: which tool: docs/recipes/16-dev-bridge.md §11

- Slow, low fps: docs/recipes/15-perf.md §1
- Deploy: docs/recipes/61-deploy.md

- [07-flow-scenes-pause](docs/recipes/07-flow-scenes-pause.md): Scene transitions and pause (flow)
- [08-weather-sky](docs/recipes/08-weather-sky.md): Add weather or change the sky
- [09-materials-lights-models](docs/recipes/09-materials-lights-models.md): Materials, lights and models: the game's own picture
- [10-blender-level](docs/recipes/10-blender-level.md): Importing Blender models and levels
- [11-vehicles](docs/recipes/11-vehicles.md): Physics: rigid bodies, pushing, joints, vehicles
- [12-navmesh](docs/recipes/12-navmesh.md): Navigation mesh (nav)
- [13-animation](docs/recipes/13-animation.md): Animation state machine (skeletal animation)
- [14-custom-module](docs/recipes/14-custom-module.md): Custom module
- [15-perf](docs/recipes/15-perf.md): Performance investigation (F3, budget, profile, describe().perf)
- [16-dev-bridge](docs/recipes/16-dev-bridge.md): Dev bridge: operate the running game from the terminal (threedog describe / step / press / op...)
- [18-world](docs/recipes/18-world.md): World data: things that must be saved, grow, and keep changing while far away
- [19-shooting-picking](docs/recipes/19-shooting-picking.md): Shooting and picking (cast a ray from the screen center or the mouse position, with any camera)
- [20-content-actions-save](docs/recipes/20-content-actions-save.md): Content vocabulary, key actions in actions.js, saving and loading at startup
- [21-camera](docs/recipes/21-camera.md): Camera: first / third person, top-down strategy, fixed shots, switched at runtime
- [22-shop-gold](docs/recipes/22-shop-gold.md): Shop and gold: buy, sell / consign, gold HUD, saving
- [23-ops](docs/recipes/23-ops.md): Ops: one entry point for what players and NPCs do (engine.ops)
- [26-ui-parts](docs/recipes/26-ui-parts.md): UI parts: replace or turn off any piece of the engine's screen UI
- [27-net](docs/recipes/27-net.md): Co-op multiplayer: net() (host authority + state sync)
- [28-terrain](docs/recipes/28-terrain.md): Terrain: your own generator, digging, raising and painting the ground, islands
- [29-grid](docs/recipes/29-grid.md): Grid placement: towers, furniture, buildings, crops
- [30-templates](docs/recipes/30-templates.md): Templates: reusable objects, definition vs instance state
- [31-audio](docs/recipes/31-audio.md): Sound: buses, sounds by name, ambience rules, music, footsteps, ducking
- [32-action-game](docs/recipes/32-action-game.md): Action game wiring: hp, attacks, guns, enemy AI, drops, death, win and lose without engine combat rules
- [33-stream-sources](docs/recipes/33-stream-sources.md): Stream sources: what is loaded where (teleport, far camera)
- [34-environment-lighting](docs/recipes/34-environment-lighting.md): Lights, fog, exposure and environment lighting
- [35-picture-from-reference](docs/recipes/35-picture-from-reference.md): Making a new picture from a reference picture
- [36-ground-plants](docs/recipes/36-ground-plants.md): Ground color and plants
- [40-scene](docs/recipes/40-scene.md): Scene: what is in the world, where, who manages it, and what a save keeps (engine.thing)
- [43-shader-patches-surfaces](docs/recipes/43-shader-patches-surfaces.md): Writing shader patches and surfaces
- [44-water-weather-hooks](docs/recipes/44-water-weather-hooks.md): Water and rain/snow: depth color, foam, reflections, particles, snow cover, lightning
- [45-cascaded-shadows](docs/recipes/45-cascaded-shadows.md): Shadows: cascades, box, budget, cache, the switch
- [46-blender-art-route](docs/recipes/46-blender-art-route.md): Blender to game (GLB) route
- [49-game-module-contract](docs/recipes/49-game-module-contract.md): Writing a game system module (a smelter, a recharging turret, growing crops) that plugs into the engine's contracts
- [50-own-renderer](docs/recipes/50-own-renderer.md): Bring your own renderer: `createEngine({ renderer })`
- [51-capability-catalog](docs/recipes/51-capability-catalog.md): Capability catalog: ask what the game can do before reading docs
- [52-around-the-picture](docs/recipes/52-around-the-picture.md): 52 Around the picture: reading it back, the post chain, who writes what
- [53-ground-up-close](docs/recipes/53-ground-up-close.md): The ground up close: options, crisp color borders, normals, diagnosis
- [55-mods-time-wrap](docs/recipes/55-mods-time-wrap.md): Shared values, exclusive slots, time channels and wrapping module methods
- [56-webgpu-tsl](docs/recipes/56-webgpu-tsl.md): WebGPU and your own TSL materials
- [57-control](docs/recipes/57-control.md): Who steers a character: engine.control
- [58-input](docs/recipes/58-input.md): Input: modules declare actions, the game binds keys
- [59-depth-post-effects](docs/recipes/59-depth-post-effects.md): A post effect that reads depth (volumetric fog, god rays)
- [60-judge-the-picture](docs/recipes/60-judge-the-picture.md): 60 Make the picture look good: what each knob does and how to judge it
- [61-deploy](docs/recipes/61-deploy.md): Deploy: put the built game on a web server, at the site root or under a sub-path
- [62-picture-code](docs/recipes/62-picture-code.md): The whole picture in plain three.js: signals in, picture out
- [63-third-person-start](docs/recipes/63-third-person-start.md): Third-person start: walking, camera, save, pause, menu
- [64-particles](docs/recipes/64-particles.md): Particles: dust, smoke, sparks, splashes
- [65-swarm](docs/recipes/65-swarm.md): Swarm: shots, crowds, pickups, debris by the thousand
- [66-common-tasks](docs/recipes/66-common-tasks.md): Common tasks, complete
